tenderSchedule.description: Annual Tender Animal Birth Control (ABC) and Anti Rabies Vaccination (ARV) in TMC Chandapura

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Mandating Satisfactory Completion Certificate for atleast one similar work to an extent of 50% of the cost of Work
Scanned copies of relevant registration certificate issued by competent authorities AWBI registered AWOSOCIETY ACT or COMPANIES ACT

Details of number of proposed dog-catching vehicles, dog catchers, operation theaters, veterinary doctors, other staff, other equipment and facilities available (enclose relevant documents). Undertaking to arrange for the required land / kennel facilities with water and electricity and facilities like operation theaters, post-operative care, dog catching van, dog catchers, Drivers and qualified, registered veterinary professionals and other supporting staff.

To Qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period (a) achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.7.65 Lakhs (i.e from 2021-22 to 2025-26).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than amount Rs.4.5 lakhs
